screen_awareness._comment: Sends periodic screenshots of the display to the OpenAI API. Set bbox [x1,y1,x2,y2] to watch only the game region. A run of same-kind moments (death, win, boss) inside same_kind_window_seconds is held until streak_threshold unsaid repeats have gone by, and a dead-air filler within filler_screen_gap_seconds of a screen line is steered off the screen. Runs are counted per kind and menus are never moments; a moment is dropped when a viewer has spoken in the last yield_to_chat_seconds, and for room_followup_seconds after an unprompted line the first viewer message is answered as if it named the co-host. model is the vision model; it always runs on the OpenAI API with OPENAI_API_KEY, independent of llm_model and of any LLM_BASE_URL chat endpoint.

topic_wells._comment: Code picks what a dead-air filler is about before the model writes: the game, what the streamer just said, earlier tonight, a question for chat, a viewer callback, or one off_topic entry. game_share_max over the last window lines caps the game (0.34 of 6 = at most 2, never twice running). off_topic is a plain list you can edit. enabled false = the old game-only filler exactly.

laugh_probe._comment: Instrumentation only: scores mic audio Whisper found no words in and logs '[LAUGH-PROBE] fired' so the post-stream audit can say whether a laugh detector would work here. Nothing reads the score yet. onnx_model_path is empty until a model file is placed by hand; nothing downloads.
